name: openmail
description: Hosted, provider-agnostic IMAP/SMTP MCP server for AI agents

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && mkdir -p dist/web/static && cp src/web/static/* dist/web/static/
scripts.test:integration: docker compose -f docker-compose.test.yml up -d --wait && node scripts/wait-for-tcp.mjs 127.0.0.1 ${OPENMAIL_TEST_IMAP_PORT:-13143} 127.0.0.1 ${OPENMAIL_TEST_SMTP_PORT:-13025} && OPENMAIL_INTEGRATION=1 vitest run tests/integration
